products.name: ViewSonic VX1655-4K-OLED 15.6" 4K OLED Portable Monitor
products.summary: 15.6-inch 4K OLED portable monitor with 100% DCI-P3, dual 60 W USB-C and a built-in kickstand.
products.description: The VX1655-4K-OLED is a 1.5 lb portable 15.6-inch 3840x2160 OLED display with 100% DCI-P3, 400 nits and 0.05 ms response. Two USB-C ports with 60 W pass-through charging and a mini-HDMI 2.0 input connect laptops, consoles and phones; a kickstand supports portrait and landscape.

products.name: ViewSonic ColorPro VP16-OLED 15.6" OLED Portable Monitor
products.summary: 15.6-inch 1080p Pantone-validated OLED portable monitor with dual 40 W USB-C, stand and protective cover.
products.description: The VP16-OLED is a 15.6-inch 1920x1080 OLED portable monitor with 10-bit colour, 400 nits and Pantone validation. Dual USB-C ports with 40 W power delivery and micro-HDMI connect laptops and cameras, and it ships with a height-adjustable stand (tripod mountable) and a protective cover.
products.keywords: portable oled monitor pantone usb-c creator
